title: Tenma Tsukasa — Meat Gives You Energy!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Ah, there is nothing like flowers growing by the side of the road...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“These look like pansies.
Their various colors, forms and aromas are wonderful.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And what do we have here growing in this flower bed...?”
Huh? Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, everyone!
Having lunch in the courtyard today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since it's so nice out. We decided to have lunch in the courtyard while getting some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What were you doing just now, Tsukasa? It looked like you were talking to the flowers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that?
I was just getting into character for my next role!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your next role? For a show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, not for a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it so happens, Wonderlands×Showtime is going to be in a feature film!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! A film?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's incredible news...!
What's your character going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, get ready.
I'll be playing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Young Man A, who squats while admiring flowers!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Young Man A? Admiring flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Correct! We're going to be extras!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It may not be glamorous, but we nonetheless get to play people who live in this film's world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm getting into character because I plan on being the most believable flower-admiring man I can be!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. As always, Tsukasa, I'm impressed by your work ethic. No matter the role, you're giving it everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Giving it everything you have is fine and all... But to be honest, you looked more suspicious than usual just now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, you were smiling while talking to those flowers... Everyone started backing away from you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, you're practicing here at school. That's quite the dedication.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
There's a reason why I'm practicing here at school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A reason?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
The thing is, when I was given this role, I went outside to look for some flowers to practice with...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But every time I tried talking to some, the children in my neighborhood started giving me these strange looks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I decided that it wasn't right of me to make them feel uncomfortable.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'm practicing here at school where it shouldn't be a bother to anyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, you were still getting a lot of weird looks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, after getting a chance to look at all these flowers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's clear that the ones at school are much more robust than the ones in the park.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Robust?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. The flowers in the park are all very pretty, but the ones here at school...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They seem much more vibrant for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The leaves are this rich green color, and each petal seems to be brimming with life...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What if these are the ones that Rui and the other members of the greening committee have been looking after?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, you may be right...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just hope they aren't using any funny fertilizers...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... I mean, they seem pretty healthy, so there's probably nothing wrong with them... I hope...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I have heard that certain dangerous insects like to hide in flower beds. Please try to keep that in mind, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Toya, I appreciate the concern!
However, there is no need for you to worry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Because...
This bug spray here will keep me safe!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You've come prepared.
My concerns were misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, your words still mean something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And having others watch gives me the motivation I need to succeed... I can't help but feel even more excited about being in this film!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know much about filmmaking, but I wish you the best. You'll always have my support.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, make it a double! I wanna go see it when it releases♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent. I'll let you all know when we hear about the release date. So, until then, stay tuned!
